anchors.paper_title: A comparison of the discrete and dimensional models of emotion in music
anchors.reason: Eerola & Vuoskoski (2010) compares discrete and dimensional emotion models and introduces film music stimuli, likely the source of the clips. It is not this EEG dataset's data paper.

anchors.paper_title: Neural correlates of emotional responses to music: An EEG study
anchors.reason: Daly et al. 2014 is an earlier analysis of music-induced emotion EEG; README says the dataset accompanies Daly et al. (2018) and was only analysed in the 2014 paper.

anchors.paper_title: Changes in music tempo entrain movement related brain activity
anchors.reason: Daly et al. 2014 EMBC analyzes music tempo and movement-related EEG; the README lists it as an earlier analysis, while the data paper is Daly et al. 2018.

anchors.paper_title: Music-induced emotions can be predicted from a combination of brain activity and acoustic features
anchors.reason: Daly et al. 2015 (Brain and Cognition) is an earlier analysis of this data; the README says the dataset accompanies Daly et al. 2018, so this paper is not the data paper.

metadata.methods_description: Six EEG runs per participant: resting-state runs of 300 s at the start and end, and four runs of 10 music-listening trials each. Stimuli were 12 s film-score excerpts from Eerola & Vuoskoski stimulus set 1, rated for induced emotion. EEG was sampled at 1 kHz.
